item.title: Malaysia Short Of Nearly 6,000 Vets, Says DVS
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia is facing a severe shortage of nearly 6,000 veterinarians, says the DVS, as the country only has 2,600 active vets compared to 8,500 needed. The ratio of vets to people in Malaysia is 1:13,700, far worse than the international standard of 1:5,000. The post Malaysia Short Of Nearly 6,000 Vets, Says DVS appeared first on CodeBlue .
